expected_structural_facts.source_location: Independent pypdf inspection of the official artifact

hard_facts: A disabled submersible may rest on the sea floor or reach neutral buoyancy underwater.
Currents, density variation, and sea-floor geography can affect its position.
Location uncertainty must be represented rather than replaced by a single deterministic point.
historical_quality_signals: Couples uncertainty propagation to search deployment rather than treating them as unrelated tasks.
Updates probability of detection as negative search results accumulate.
Makes operational recommendations with readiness and cost tradeoffs.
known_constraints: Minimize time to locate the lost submersible.
Determine probability of finding it as a function of time and accumulated search results.
Include a two-page memo to the Greek government.
known_invalid_approaches: Reporting a deterministic trajectory without uncertainty bounds.
Selecting search patterns independently of the location probability distribution.
Assuming surface-search sensor performance applies unchanged underwater.
reasonable_model_families: stochastic drift or particle-filter location model
reference_ranges: Search performance should be represented by time-dependent probability of detection.
Uncertainty and sensor assumptions must be explicit and sensitivity-tested.
required_outputs: A model predicting submersible location over time with quantified uncertainty.
Recommended pre-incident telemetry and supporting equipment.
Recommended host-ship and rescue-vessel search equipment with readiness and cost tradeoffs.
Initial deployment points and search patterns minimizing time to location.
Probability of finding the submersible over time with accumulated search outcomes.
Extensions to the Caribbean and multiple nearby submersibles.
A two-page memo to the Greek government.
